title: Aorist and Future Passive Verbs
objectives: recognize and write the aorist and future passive indicative paradigms,
know the passive stem forms of some of the major verbs learned in previous lessons,
translate aorist and future passive indicative forms,
gain more practice in translating and working with Greek,
master 10 more high frequency vocabulary words,

content.text: In English we form the past passive indicative by using a helping verb (e.g. I was struck by the foul ball).
Similarly, the future passive indicative is formed with the helping "will be" (e.g. I will be flown to Indianapolis).
Rather than using a helping verb, Greek uses a different stem to indicate the passive indicative for aorist and future tenses. In the lexicon this stem will be the sixth (last) principal part.

content._disclosure: The six principal parts print as a labelled two-row grid in the original; emitted as labelled rows so every form taps. The labels are underlined in the original and render WITHOUT the underline (3.2: green underline is exclusive to tappable elements, and a column label is not one).

learn.title: Learn Aorist and Future Passive Verbs

content.text: Greek aorist and future passive forms are translated like the English past passive and future passives.

They are built from the sixth principal part of the verb. They are easily recognized because of the characteristic θ just before the ending. Like other past tense verb forms aorist passives take the augment.
The aorist passives are formed by adding θη before the ending:

lines.text: Aug   Stem   Pass   Ending   (I was loosed)

content.text: The future passives add θησ before the ending and drop the augment.

lines.text: Stem   Pass   Ending   (I will be loosed)

content._verify_note: The original prints "lu + qhs + n = luqh<somai" -- the ending shown is nu although the form ends -omai. Carried VERBATIM; an original slip, not a conversion error. VERIFY.

content.text: When a stem ends in a consonant the following changes take place when the θη is added.

parts.text: φ causes the θ to drop out

topics.title: Consonant Shifts

parts.text: τ, δ, and θ  become  σ
ζ, ξ, and ψ  become  σ

topics.title: Deponent

content.text: Some verbs that are deponent in the present will use a passive form in the aorist (ἀπεκρίθην) rather than the expected middle (deponent) form. Regardless of the form (middle or passive), deponent aorist verbs will be translated with an active sense. Thus, ἀπεκρίθην is translated "I answered". Others have both middle (ἐγενόμην) and passive forms (ἐγενήθην).

items.greek: Ὁ προφήτης εἶ σύ; καὶ ἀπεκρίθη, Οὔ
options: Are you the prophet? and he said, "No"
Are you the prophet? and they answered, "No"
Are you the prophet? and he answered, "No"
items.answer: Are you the prophet? and he answered, "No"

items.greek: Ἀπεκρίθησαν καὶ εἶπαν αὐτῷ, Ὁ πατὴρ ἡμῶν
options: he answered and said to him, "Our father is Abraham"
they answered and said to him, "Our father is Abraham"
he answered and said to them, "My father is Abraham"
items.answer: they answered and said to him, "Our father is Abraham"

items.greek: ἐγὼ δὲ ἀπεκρίθην, Τίς εἶ, κύριε; εἶπέν τε πρός
options: And I answered, "Who are you Lord?" and he said to me, "I am Jesus"
And we answered, "Who are you Lord?" and he said to me, "I am Jesus"
And they answered me, "Who are you Lord?" and I said to them, "I am Jesus"
items.answer: And I answered, "Who are you Lord?" and he said to me, "I am Jesus"

items.greek: Καὶ ὅτε εἶδεν ὁ δράκων ὅτι ἐβλήθη εἰς τὴν γῆν
options: and when they saw the dragon that he was cast to the earth
and when the dragon saw that he was cast to the earth
and when the dragon saw that they were cast to the earth
items.answer: and when the dragon saw that he was cast to the earth

items.greek: καὶ οἱ ἄγγελοι αὐτοῦ μετ' αὐτοῦ ἐβλήθησαν
options: and his angels were cast down with him
and the angels against him cast him down
and he was cast down with his angels
items.answer: and his angels were cast down with him

items.greek: καὶ εἴ τις οὐχ εὑρέθη ἐν τῇ βίβλῳ τῆς ζωῆς
options: and if you are not found in the book of life
and if they were not found in the book of life
and if anyone was not found in the book of life
items.answer: and if anyone was not found in the book of life

Jesus answered and said to them, "Destroy this temple and I will raise it"

items.greek: ἀπεκρίθη Ἰησοῦς καὶ εἶπεν αὐτῷ , Ἀμὴν ἀμὴν

Jesus answered and they said to him, "Truly, truly, We say to you"

items.greek: Ἠκούσατε ὅτι ἐρρέθη, Ὀφθαλμὸν ἀντὶ ὀφθαλμοῦ
options: You (pl.) have heard what they said, "Eye for an eye"
You (sg.) have heard that it was said, "Eye for an eye"
You (pl.) have heard that it was said, "Eye for an eye"
items.answer: You (pl.) have heard that it was said, "Eye for an eye"

items.greek: καὶ ἐκρίθησαν ἕκαστος κατὰ τὰ ἔργα αὐτῶν
options: and he was judged, each according to his works
and they were judged, each according to their works
and they were judged, each according to his works
items.answer: and they were judged, each according to their works

items.greek: καὶ ἐσώθη ἡ γυνὴ ἀπὸ τῆς ὥρας ἐκείνης
options: and they made the woman well from that hour
and he made the woman well from that hour
and the woman was made well from that hour
items.answer: and the woman was made well from that hour

items.greek: Πᾶς γὰρ ὅς ἄν ἐπικαλέσηται τὸ ὄνομα κυρίου
options: for anyone who calls on the name of the Lord will be saved
for all who call on the name of the Lord they will be saved
for everyone who calls on the name of the Lord and be saved
items.answer: for anyone who calls on the name of the Lord will be saved

items.greek: ἀπεκρίθη αὐτῳ Ναθαναήλ, Ῥαββί, σύ εἶ ὁ υἱὸς
options: he answered Nathanael, "Rabbi, are you the son of God?"
Nathanael answered him, "Rabbi, you are the son of God"
Nathanael answered them, "Rabbi, he is the son of God"
items.answer: Nathanael answered him, "Rabbi, you are the son of God"
